messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-4721 fired — inference-gateway-prod 5xx error rate spike > 5% (1m) policy: infra-critical. Link: https://pd.internal/redwood/PD-4721 :rotating_light:
jamal: Acked. I'm on it.
jamal: looking at dash now — graphs show a sharp jump at 09:02 UTC from eu-west1.
matt: rolled canary at 09:03 UTC (deploy abc123 -> abc124).
natalie: support queue: multiple customers reporting timeouts and 502s, mostly EU region. raising flags with account SQs.
jamal: quick check — listing gateway pods and recent restarts
jamal: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep gateway
gateway-0   1/1  Running   0    2d
gateway-1   0/1  CrashLoop  5    3m
gateway-canary-0 0/1 CrashLoop  6  2m
```
jamal: tail of gateway canary logs shows repeated upstream resets to model-proxy: `upstream read: connection reset by peer`
jamal: pattern looks like proxy->model process failing with OOM or connection refuse, not just transient network.
matt: I can revert the canary now if you want.
jamal: doing rollback now:```bash
kubectl rollout undo deploy/gateway -n inference --to-revision=41
# scaling to buy time
kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=6 -n inference
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4721 acknowledged by jamal
support-bot: Auto-note: incident matched customer-impact rule. ~2.1% of total requests affected, primary region: eu-west1. No evidence of data loss.
natalie: drafting status page update and pinging top 3 affected customers (ACME, BrightDesk, BlueSky).
jamal: rollback kicked in, new pods coming up. monitoring logs.
jamal: post-rollback logs (extract):```
[09:06:12] gateway: started worker pid=1234
[09:06:22] gateway: proxy->model connection established
[09:06:25] gateway: 5xx_count: 8 -> 1 over 1m
```
jamal: 5xx rate dropping to ~0.9% now, still watching for flapping.
matt: I'll temporarily route EU traffic to the stable model-variant via routing rule to avoid further churn. adding rule: `route /v1/infer -> variant:stable-eu`
tim: I'm next oncall in 12 mins. if handoff needed, say the word and I'll take over.
jamal: thanks — I'll keep it and handoff to you if it stays stable.
natalie: support: sending proactive emails to affected customers and opening PS tickets.
matt: quick note — canary logs showed a spike in memory usage right before crashes, likely regression in model-proxy mem handling. flagging research.
jamal: creating incident-xyz in ops (INC-2026) and adding links to runbook and deploy history.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4721 status changed to resolved by system after incident annotations.
jamal: Confirming: error rate back to baseline <1% for 3 consecutive minutes. marking mitigation complete.
natalie: support queued follow-ups. we've informed accounts and offered timeline for RCA.
tim: I'll pick this up for follow-up doc and RCA. please @me with the deploy diffs and any heap dumps.
matt: saving canary pods and logs to s3://redwood-incidents/PD-4721/logs for postmortem. Also saving heapdump if available.
jamal: postmortem owner: tim. severity: P1 -> reduced to P2 for internal follow-up. action items: reproduce mem spike locally, add canary health gating, add automatic rollback if x% 5xx in 2m.
natalie: ETA for RCA draft: EOD tomorrow.
jamal: reassigning incident doc to @tim. closing Slack thread for real-time ops. thanks all :thumbsup:
